description: A savings group keeps an account for each member and records deposits and withdrawals.
data: accounts with the owner's name and a balance
transactions on an account with a kind (deposit or withdrawal) and an amount
actions: members see the transactions of an account
the treasurer sees all accounts and all transactions
rules: a new account starts with nothing in it
nobody can withdraw more than is in the account
amounts must be more than zero
the balance is kept by the system
